name: Today, I'm Harvesting You!
source:
We’re all gonna die anyways. Somehow. Someday.

That’s life.

Very poor and very tired of being single, you set out for your day with one goal: change both of those things, no matter the cost!!

[From [url=https://robobarbie.itch.io/today-im-harvesting-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
无论如何我们都会死。不知何故。有一天。

这就是生活。

非常贫穷并且厌倦了单身，你带着一个目标开始新的一天：改变这两件事，无论付出什么代价！

[来自[url=https://robobarbie.itch.io/today-im-harvesting-you]Itch.io[/url]]
